messages:
acme_ops: Hey team — since ~09:10 UTC we're seeing p95 token latency jump to ~1.4s and intermittent 429s from our dedicated pool (ded-pool-eu2-a). Only our tenant seems impacted. Happens after long requests finish and warmup. Any ideas?

sarah_support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you share a couple sample request IDs and confirm you're on MIG partitions? Also pls paste a short curl repro + `redwood status` output if possible.

acme_ops: We're on Dedicated with MIG slices (A100 1g_10gb). Sample req ids: req_20260301_abc123, req_20260301_def456. 429 payload: "slice throttled: p95 exceeded". Minimal repro: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-1.3","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sarah_support: thanks — routing shows tenant pinned to ded-pool-eu2-a (hosts host-44, host-45). Autoscale logs show NO scale-up in that 09:05-09:20 window. tagging runtime: @josh_eng-runtime

josh_eng-runtime: looked at host-44 metrics: MIG slice ids OK, but slice-2 on host-44 shows KV-cache miss rate spikes and SM utilization hitting ~98% around 09:09-09:12. L3 and memory bandwidth also high. Could be cross-slice L3 thrash from neighbor batching. Do you have request length distribution?

acme_ops: Mostly short chat turns (~60 tokens) but we have bursts of 400–800 token runs every ~5m. The p95 jump tends to come right after a heavy long-run finishes. Also noticed ~70% of requests were routed to host-44 in that window.

lee_sre: infra telemetry: host-44 had another tenant running aggressive batching jobs in the same time window (1–2 min bursts). That would evict KV cache entries and cause warmup penalty for your slices. Also saw MIG packing fragmentation preventing consolidation.

akiko_ml: can you paste MIG layout + nvidia outputs? e.g. `nvidia-smi mig -lgci` and output of slice utilization. Also `nvidia-smi topo -m` if available.

acme_ops: Paste snapshot:
```
MIG config: 4 x 1g_10gb per GPU (slice ids 0..3)
host-44: slice-2 SM util spikes to 98%, L3 util ~82%
node routing: host-44 primary for tenant
```

sarah_support: short-term mitigation: we can pin your tenant off host-44 to host-45 and force KV cache rehydrate. That normally drops p95 quickly. Want us to proceed?

acme_ops: Yes please. Also we'd like to understand why autoscaler didn't add burst capacity.

autoscale-bot: autoscale event: no burst nodes added during 09:05-09:20 — reason: capacity quota exhausted in eu2 region (quota check failed).

josh_eng-runtime: follow-up from runtime logs: allocator saw fragmentation and could not coalesce slices onto spare GPUs; packing policy kept slices spread and we hit cross-slice interference. Filing infra ticket to review packing heuristics. For now we've moved your tenant to host-45 and enabled temporary request smoothing (short token-delay window) plus a small rate-limit buffer.

acme_ops: After the move p95 dropped to ~190ms and 429s stopped. Thanks, that fixed it for now.

lee_sre: creating incident INC-20260301-87 for postmortem: action items: improve burst fallback (spill to whole-GPU variant when MIG contention high), add packing defrag job, and better quota alarming to avoid autoscale silent-failures.

sarah_support: closing the immediate escalation; will follow up with infra postmortem notes and recommended customer guidance for heavy-burst workloads. :white_check_mark:
